purpose: Emphasize completing an action despite difficulty.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
Even though it was hard, I ran all the way to the end.
After thinking it through thoroughly, I chose this answer.
Together with my companions, I survived the harsh winter.
restrictions: Often implies persistence through hardship until the end.
mistake: It means carrying through, not merely removing something.
